title: Radar network: the range equation in 3D
summary: Three moving radars and four moving targets in a projected 3D scene give 36 transmitter-receiver-target links. Each link shows its bistatic radar equation with numerical substitutions in MathJax, the matched-filter SNR, the thermal-noise detector threshold, the required SNR, the margin, delay and Doppler. Sampled range-Doppler processing with clutter patches, direct paths, self-leakage and seeded noise, Swerling 0 to 4, coherent and noncoherent integration, coherent site combination, published MathWorks reference cases, a separate NASA F-117 model-curve evidence panel, JSON import and export and a narrated beamdswitch deck. All absolute values are synthetic. Works offline: MathJax 4.1.3 and Fira Math are embedded.
